- `SAME_CUSTOMER`: Cannot merge a customer with itself.

- `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` function
  - Removes the fromId customer from the customers array
  - Updates all invoices with customerId = fromId to reference intoId
  - Returns ok({ customers, invoices }) with merged data
  - Errors: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND (if either ID missing), SAME_CUSTOMER (if both IDs identical)
  - Normalizes customer IDs for comparison
  - Never mutates input arguments

- Basic merge functionality (removing customer, updating invoices)
- Error cases (same customer, missing IDs)
- ID normalization (case/whitespace handling)
- Immutability (doesn't mutate inputs)
- Edge cases (empty arrays, multiple invoices, order preservation)
